currentAccountAlerts.headline: ⚠️ US Combined Twin Deficit at -9.8% of GDP ($1.85T Annual Absorptive Need)
currentAccountAlerts.body: A current account deficit of -3.4% combined with a fiscal shortfall of -6.4% demands continuous foreign debt absorption amid shrinking foreign official reserve shares.

currentAccountAlerts.headline: 🚢 China Goods Trade Surplus Hits $915.2B Annually
currentAccountAlerts.body: Unprecedented manufacturing competitiveness generates over $900B net trade surplus, funneled into strategic commodities, gold reserves, and non-USD bilateral trade clearing.

currentAccountAlerts.headline: ⚠️ UK Twin Deficit at -7.5% of GDP
currentAccountAlerts.body: Structural current account deficit (-3.2%) and elevated government financing needs require persistent global capital inflows to stabilize Sterling.

reerExtremeAlerts.headline: 📉 Japanese Yen at Extreme Historical Undervaluation: -22.9% vs 10Y REER Mean
reerExtremeAlerts.body: Real effective purchasing power sits at multi-decade lows (68.2), generating massive domestic import inflation while fueling export corporate profits.

reerExtremeAlerts.headline: 📈 US Dollar Real Effective Valuation Stretched: +13% Over 10Y Equilibrium
reerExtremeAlerts.body: High real yield premiums sustain elevated dollar valuations, creating headwinds for emerging market dollar-denominated debt service.

ticFlowAlerts.headline: 🏦 China US Treasury Holdings Drop Below $770B; Official Gold Share Rises to 18.4%
ticFlowAlerts.body: Foreign central banks account for just 44.5% of foreign Treasury holdings (down from 75% in 2010), accelerating sovereign reserve diversification across the BRICS+ coalition.

ticFlowAlerts.headline: 📊 Foreign Ownership Share of US Marketable Debt Diluted to 23.4%
ticFlowAlerts.body: With total marketable Treasuries crossing $36.4T, domestic US financial institutions and private asset managers bear an unprecedented share of new debt issuance.
